content_text:
Thank you so much both for your responses! No gels on set is a huge cost savings for sure.
Roger, could you expand on LEDs not quite being able to imitate moonlight?
My scope of moonlight doesn’t go further than lighting through a small window or living room  at the moment but I guess for night exteriors, such as your famous
True Grit,
I could see LEDs lacking behind?
